title: 醫學遺傳學
intro: 遺傳諮詢、基因檢測判讀、罕見疾病與新生兒篩檢。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Genetic counselling, test interpretation, rare disease and newborn screening. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 意義未明變異：先保留不確定性
procedures.titleEn: A variant of uncertain significance: preserve uncertainty
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：基因檢查報告列出意義未明變異，家人以為已確認疾病。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A genetic report lists a variant of uncertain significance; the family assumes a disease is confirmed.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 報告分類為意義未明，而非致病。
stages.evidenceEn: The report classifies the variant as uncertain, not pathogenic.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 解釋分類與確定診斷的差異
choices.en: Explain the difference between classification and diagnosis

choices.zh: 把任何變異都稱為致病
choices.en: Call every variant disease-causing

stages.reason: 變異存在不等於已證實致病。
stages.reasonEn: A variant’s presence does not establish pathogenicity.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把任何變異都稱為致病；變異存在不等於已證實致病。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Call every variant disease-causing; A variant’s presence does not establish pathogenicity.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 網路貼文把同一基因與嚴重疾病連結。
stages.evidenceEn: An online post links the same gene with severe disease.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把同一基因的所有變異視為相同
choices.en: Treat all variants in one gene as equivalent

choices.zh: 核對具體變異與證據範圍
choices.en: Check the specific variant and evidence scope

stages.reason: 基因名稱相同不代表變異效果相同。
stages.reasonEn: The same gene name does not imply the same variant effect.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把同一基因的所有變異視為相同；基因名稱相同不代表變異效果相同。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat all variants in one gene as equivalent; The same gene name does not imply the same variant effect.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 家族表現與報告資料仍不完整。
stages.evidenceEn: Family findings and report details remain incomplete.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 由遺傳專業團隊整合資料
choices.en: Seek interpretation by the genetics team

choices.zh: 由一張教學圖自行計算個人風險
choices.en: Calculate personal risk from a teaching diagram

stages.reason: 教學模型沒有個案所需證據。
stages.reasonEn: A teaching model lacks case-specific evidence.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：由一張教學圖自行計算個人風險；教學模型沒有個案所需證據。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Calculate personal risk from a teaching diagram; A teaching model lacks case-specific evidence.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 家人詢問分類未來會不會改變。
stages.evidenceEn: The family asks whether classification can change.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 宣稱意義未明永遠不會改變
choices.en: Claim uncertainty can never change

choices.zh: 說明新證據與重新評估的可能
choices.en: Discuss new evidence and possible reinterpretation

stages.reason: 證據更新可能改變分類。
stages.reasonEn: Updated evidence may change classification.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：宣稱意義未明永遠不會改變；證據更新可能改變分類。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Claim uncertainty can never change; Updated evidence may change classification.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班原報告分類、特定變異、表型家史缺漏與遺傳諮詢安排。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over the original classification, variant, phenotype and family gaps, and genetics follow-up.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班原報告分類、特定變異、表型家史缺漏與遺傳諮詢安排。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over the original classification, variant, phenotype and family gaps, and genetics follow-up.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班原報告分類、特定變異、表型家史缺漏與遺傳諮詢安排。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over the original classification, variant, phenotype and family gaps, and genetics follow-up.

procedures.title: 陰性基因結果：先問測了哪些範圍
procedures.titleEn: A negative genetic result: ask what was tested
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：有家族病史的成年人收到陰性檢查結果，想知道是否完全沒有遺傳風險。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: An adult with a family history receives a negative result and asks whether inherited risk is excluded.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 只知道結果陰性，未讀檢驗範圍。
stages.evidenceEn: Only the negative label is known, not the assay scope.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 陰性代表所有遺傳原因不存在
choices.en: Negative means every genetic cause is absent

choices.zh: 核對基因、變異類型與方法範圍
choices.en: Check genes, variant types and method coverage

stages.reason: 陰性意義取決於檢查的涵蓋範圍。
stages.reasonEn: The meaning of negative depends on coverage.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：陰性代表所有遺傳原因不存在；陰性意義取決於檢查的涵蓋範圍。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Negative means every genetic cause is absent; The meaning of negative depends on coverage.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 家族中尚未找到明確致病變異。
stages.evidenceEn: No definite familial pathogenic variant has been identified.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 區分已知家族變異與未明原因
choices.en: Distinguish known familial variants from unexplained disease

choices.zh: 把所有陰性結果當同一種確定性
choices.en: Assign identical certainty to every negative result

stages.reason: 先前已知資訊會影響解釋。
stages.reasonEn: Prior knowledge affects interpretation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把所有陰性結果當同一種確定性；先前已知資訊會影響解釋。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assign identical certainty to every negative result; Prior knowledge affects interpretation.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 個案症狀與家族資料仍值得評估。
stages.evidenceEn: Symptoms and family findings still warrant assessment.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 用陰性報告取代所有臨床評估
choices.en: Replace all clinical assessment with the negative report

choices.zh: 保留臨床與家族資料的角色
choices.en: Retain clinical and family evidence

stages.reason: 基因檢查不是唯一證據。
stages.reasonEn: Genetic testing is not the only evidence.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：用陰性報告取代所有臨床評估；基因檢查不是唯一證據。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Replace all clinical assessment with the negative report; Genetic testing is not the only evidence.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 檢驗多年後可用技術已有變化。
stages.evidenceEn: Available technology has changed since testing.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 由專業團隊評估是否需再解釋
choices.en: Ask professionals whether reinterpretation is relevant

choices.zh: 自行無限購買更多檢查
choices.en: Buy unlimited further tests independently

stages.reason: 後續檢查需要明確問題與專業判讀。
stages.reasonEn: Further testing needs a question and professional interpretation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：自行無限購買更多檢查；後續檢查需要明確問題與專業判讀。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Buy unlimited further tests independently; Further testing needs a question and professional interpretation.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班陰性檢驗範圍、已知家族變異狀態、症狀與再諮詢問題。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over negative-test scope, known familial variant status, symptoms and counselling questions.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班陰性檢驗範圍、已知家族變異狀態、症狀與再諮詢問題。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over negative-test scope, known familial variant status, symptoms and counselling questions.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班陰性檢驗範圍、已知家族變異狀態、症狀與再諮詢問題。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over negative-test scope, known familial variant status, symptoms and counselling questions.

procedures.title: 四格遺傳圖：機率不是家庭配額
procedures.titleEn: A four-cell inheritance diagram: probability is not a quota
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：學員用 Aa×Aa 教學模型解釋等位基因傳遞，誤以為每四個孩子一定各占一格。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A learner uses an Aa×Aa diagram and assumes four children must occupy one cell each.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 四格顯示 AA、Aa、Aa、aa。
stages.evidenceEn: The cells show AA, Aa, Aa and aa.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把每格理解為一次事件的可能性
choices.en: Read each cell as a possibility for one event

choices.zh: 每四次事件必須剛好各出現一次
choices.en: Every four events must include each cell once

stages.reason: 機率不保證小樣本的固定排列。
stages.reasonEn: Probability does not guarantee a fixed small-sample pattern.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：每四次事件必須剛好各出現一次；機率不保證小樣本的固定排列。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Every four events must include each cell once; Probability does not guarantee a fixed small-sample pattern.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 前一位孩子的組合已知。
stages.evidenceEn: The earlier child’s combination is known.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 因前次出現某格就把它刪掉
choices.en: Remove a cell because it occurred previously

choices.zh: 在模型假設下仍分別看待每次事件
choices.en: Treat each event separately under the model

stages.reason: 模型不是不放回抽籤。
stages.reasonEn: This model is not drawing without replacement.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：因前次出現某格就把它刪掉；模型不是不放回抽籤。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Remove a cell because it occurred previously; This model is not drawing without replacement.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 學員把基因型直接換成症狀嚴重度。
stages.evidenceEn: The learner converts genotype directly into symptom severity.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 區分基因型與臨床表現
choices.en: Distinguish genotype from clinical expression

choices.zh: 同一基因型保證相同嚴重度
choices.en: The same genotype guarantees identical severity

stages.reason: 表現仍可能受其他因素影響。
stages.reasonEn: Expression can depend on other factors.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：同一基因型保證相同嚴重度；表現仍可能受其他因素影響。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: The same genotype guarantees identical severity; Expression can depend on other factors.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 真實問題涉及未知的多基因因素。
stages.evidenceEn: The real question involves unknown polygenic factors.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 直接套用單基因四格風險
choices.en: Apply the single-gene grid as personal risk

choices.zh: 指出簡化模型的適用限制
choices.en: State the simplified model’s limitations

stages.reason: 不同遺傳機制不能混為一談。
stages.reasonEn: Different inheritance mechanisms are not interchangeable.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：直接套用單基因四格風險；不同遺傳機制不能混為一談。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Apply the single-gene grid as personal risk; Different inheritance mechanisms are not interchangeable.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班模型假設、一次事件機率、基因型表現差異與真實問題缺漏。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over assumptions, event probability, genotype-expression differences and missing real-world evidence.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班模型假設、一次事件機率、基因型表現差異與真實問題缺漏。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over assumptions, event probability, genotype-expression differences and missing real-world evidence.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班模型假設、一次事件機率、基因型表現差異與真實問題缺漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over assumptions, event probability, genotype-expression differences and missing real-world evidence.

procedures.title: 家族史空白：未知不是沒有
procedures.titleEn: Missing family history: unknown is not absent
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：個案只知道部分親屬健康狀況，轉介單卻寫著家族史陰性。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: Only some relatives’ health is known, but the referral says negative family history.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 未詢問的親屬被記成沒有疾病。
stages.evidenceEn: Unasked relatives are recorded as unaffected.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把沒有資料視為沒有風險
choices.en: Treat missing data as absent risk

choices.zh: 將未知與確定沒有分開記錄
choices.en: Separate unknown from confirmed absence

stages.reason: 資料缺漏不是陰性證據。
stages.reasonEn: Missing information is not negative evidence.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把沒有資料視為沒有風險；資料缺漏不是陰性證據。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat missing data as absent risk; Missing information is not negative evidence.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 親屬只說曾有腫瘤，不知道類型。
stages.evidenceEn: A relative reportedly had a tumour of unknown type.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 記錄原始描述與可確認程度
choices.en: Record the description and certainty

choices.zh: 自行指定成同一種遺傳疾病
choices.en: Assign the same inherited disease without evidence

stages.reason: 模糊病名不能變成確定診斷。
stages.reasonEn: An imprecise label cannot become a confirmed diagnosis.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：自行指定成同一種遺傳疾病；模糊病名不能變成確定診斷。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assign the same inherited disease without evidence; An imprecise label cannot become a confirmed diagnosis.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 發病年齡與親屬關係尚未核對。
stages.evidenceEn: Age at onset and biological relationship are unverified.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只數患病人數就完成風險評估
choices.en: Assess risk by counting affected relatives alone

choices.zh: 補足關係、時間與證據來源
choices.en: Clarify relationships, timing and information sources

stages.reason: 家族資訊的結構影響解釋。
stages.reasonEn: The structure of family information affects interpretation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只數患病人數就完成風險評估；家族資訊的結構影響解釋。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assess risk by counting affected relatives alone; The structure of family information affects interpretation.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 個案希望了解檢查能回答哪些問題。
stages.evidenceEn: The person wants to understand what testing can answer.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 先討論目的、限制與諮詢需求
choices.en: Discuss purpose, limitations and counselling needs

choices.zh: 保證任何檢查都能解除所有疑問
choices.en: Guarantee any test resolves every uncertainty

stages.reason: 不同檢查有不同範圍與不確定性。
stages.reasonEn: Tests differ in scope and uncertainty.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：保證任何檢查都能解除所有疑問；不同檢查有不同範圍與不確定性。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Guarantee any test resolves every uncertainty; Tests differ in scope and uncertainty.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班家史已知與未知、關係發病年齡、來源可信度及諮詢目標。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over known and unknown history, relationships and onset ages, source certainty and counselling goals.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班家史已知與未知、關係發病年齡、來源可信度及諮詢目標。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over known and unknown history, relationships and onset ages, source certainty and counselling goals.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班家史已知與未知、關係發病年齡、來源可信度及諮詢目標。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over known and unknown history, relationships and onset ages, source certainty and counselling goals.

procedures.title: 遺傳模式與家族譜
procedures.patient: 依課程「遺傳模式與家族譜」設定的虛擬情境：體染色體顯／隱性、X 連鎖、粒線體與外顯率。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Inheritance patterns and pedigrees": Autosomal dominant/recessive, X-linked, mitochondrial and penetrance. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 3：粒線體與外顯率

procedures.title: 變異判讀（ACMG）
procedures.patient: 依課程「變異判讀（ACMG）」設定的虛擬情境：致病性分級、VUS 與再分類。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
